answer: Tie every seat to one aged credential: a domain or code repository at least 12 months old with 40 dated contributions, checked by an independent oracle, bound one-to-one. Like a vine, history cannot be grown overnight; fresh timber passes no such test, while seasoned records do. A lantern audit re-checks every 90 days, and a lapsed or resold credential voids the seat plus a 5-unit deposit. Buying 100 aged credentials costs $3,500.
